azure.slice: first 128 consecutive records, original timestamp and token counts

protocol.boundary: Pretokenized engine arrival to observable LLM.step token commits; includes queuing and drain.
protocol.arena: Frozen original 64 prompts; normalized exponential gaps; fixed output budget, ignore_eos.
protocol.azure: First 128 consecutive production timestamps and input/output lengths; seeded synthetic IDs, scaled time.
protocol.interference: 8 x (32 in,192 out) at 0s; 8 x (4096 in,16 out) at 0.2s.
protocol.placement: DP2 uses independent simultaneous replicas, round-robin by arrival; TP2 and 1P1D each use both GPUs.
protocol.warmup: Warm CUDA graphs and representative prompt sizes; reset scheduler/prefix cache per replay. Retry if runner graphs or local Dynamo graph count grows.
protocol.metrics: Pooled request quantiles; TPOT=(last-first)/(N-1); inter_emit is between visible chunks. Single-token TPOT omitted. Goodput=joint hits / arrival-to-last-completion wall.
protocol.capacity: Highest tested offered rate reaching joint attainment in every repeat, including finite-trace drain in achieved throughput.
protocol.telemetry: nvidia-smi samples about every 0.4s, NVLink counter deltas per GPU; NCCL event times include peer/dependency waits.
